name: DepthLayers
note: Baselines are regression references. A visual change re-writes them with --approve and needs critic approval (system rule).

critic.notes: Lite regression baselines (p0 bare backdrop, a1 title settled, p50/p100 counter settled), far grid raised to ink3 and now readable. Depth verb confirmed on the standard evidence strip (reports/p7/evidence/fx-b/DepthLayers_parallax.jpg), not on the lite stills alone. Non-blocking carry-overs: near plane (NilePay) smaller than mid (400 EGP); hard-edged scrim rectangle behind counter; counter label small/low contrast; DOF off (CR-017); a lite-tier baseline cannot show bokeh/haze, so any future change to the standard backdrop must be checked against the strip.
